#- name: Big Cave
#- version: 1.0
#- author: qwark tests
#- description: A cave several chunks long, to exercise the chunked cave writer.

# rack.bin is 10240 bytes, which is two full MOD_CAVE_CHUNKs and a short one.
0x00700000: rack.bin

# Two patch words, which must go in after every byte of the cave has landed.
0x00740000: 0x48000008
0x00740004: 0x60000000
